csv_project_name: CM Service for Los Angeles Tennis Center Seismic Remediation
csv_scope_of_work: This project will improve the Los Angeles Tennis Center (LATC) from a Seismic Performance Rating of VI to at least IV to ensure compliance with the UC Seismic Safety Policy. Accessibility and code-compliance improvements triggered by the seismic work are included, along with upgrades to address waterproofing and stormwater drainage deficiencies. Located in the heart of campus, west of Pauley Pavilion and south of Drake Stadium, the LATC is one of the nation s premier collegiate tennis facilities.
